summary: A WhatsApp recruiter promoted fake arbitrage setups using Trust Wallet and DEX links promising high short term returns then manipulated victims into executing transactions that drained USDT and redirected funds. After losses scammers used fake SushiSwap support on Telegram to demand duplicate recovery transactions
user_mistake: trusted WhatsApp trading mentor and executed scam setup
prevention: Reject profit guaranteed setup groups / Verify support channels only through official platform sources
